player_0.content: New plan: I failed to update the graph correctly after revisiting rooms, specifically leaving the "edges" dictionary empty even when moving between known rooms (e.g., moving from Balcony to Nursery should have added an edge, but I only updated the nodes list). I also failed to track which rooms had been fully explored to determine when to stop. Next time, I will strictly update the "edges" dictionary for every move, adding the connection between the current room and the previous room (or the room being entered) in the correct direction, and I will maintain a mental or explicit list of visited rooms to ensure I only stop when no unvisited neighbors remain.
